blocks start at owner/assistant;
tool_call/tool_result join the block
they follow (atomic exchanges)

2. _count_messages per block
tokens at the project_messages boundary
(cl100k_base ≈ DeepSeek tokenizer);
system prompt counted once,
tool schemas never counted

div.div:
3. pin the newest owner message
walk blocks from the newest end;
the pin and everything newer
are never dropped

div.div:
4. drop oldest blocks until budget holds
5. if the pin still overflows: return the
pin alone, token_count > token_budget
(never raise, never drop the pin)

token_budget, created_at
